briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multimodal AGI benchmarks amid escalating safety gaps.

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as frontier labs push multimodal models with unprecedented capabilities. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny are reshaping deployment timelines. Safety remains a lagging indicator across production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with native video reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus benchmarks exceed 92% on MMLU. DeepSeek-V3 undercuts pricing by 60% while Meta open-sources Llama 4 weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic workflows amid rising adversarial attacks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft announces $45B hyperscale expansion in Texas. xAI Colossus cluster hits 200k H100 equivalents this quarter.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow US labs more than Chinese state-backed efforts by 2027?
